subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from tool-result text, or only render trusted structured image blocks/media-store references?
rationale: The branch crosses from tool/model text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, which needs maintainer intent before a safe implementation can be selected.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep the path-read shape only with explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57592 until a maintainer sponsors the security boundary and product shape.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest sampled history across the TUI renderer and image_generate feature that meet at this boundary.
